messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated cache miss rate detected in us-west inference pool. Root thread ts=2249990000.

sandeep (eng-oncall): ACK. I'm on it. Initial check: overall p50 latency up ~200ms, p95 up ~1.2s. Correlating with KV cache miss rate spike for prefix namespace "pref-tenant-T123".

vic (sre): seeing same in dashboards. Cache hit-rate dropped from 96% -> 54% for that prefix window. Traffic to origin backends up ~3.6x for those keys.

elaine (eng-runtime): any deploys recently that touched prefetch/cache invalidation? I don't see commits in the last 3h.

sandeep (eng-oncall): no deploys. Could be hotkey or malformed TTLs. Quick mitigation proposal:
- apply temporary per-tenant request throttling for T123 (limit to 120 rps)
- enable prefix bypass for correctness on a subset of pods (so reads go direct to backend but don't flush global cache)
- add traffic shaping: route 30% of T123 traffic to a small pool with disabled prefetch

jen (support): Heads-up: support ticket #2025 from AcmeCorp reporting slow responses for their webhooks. Likely T123.

elaine (eng-runtime): I'm going to stage a config change. Will coordinate with deploy-bot for gradual rollout. Steps:

```
# temporary throttle for tenant T123
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/tenants/T123/actions -d '{"throttle_rps":120}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'

# enable prefix bypass on pool 'hotfix-1'
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/pools/hotfix-1/config -d '{"prefix_bypass": true, "bypass_selectors": ["pref-tenant-T123"]}'
```

deploy-bot: Received config push request. Will do canary to 2 pods in us-west.

sandeep (eng-oncall): Before you push, let's snapshot current KV metrics and set alert guardrails. Also prepare rollback command.

```
# snapshot
curl https://metrics/api/query?q="kv_hit_rate{prefix=\"pref-tenant-T123\"}" > /tmp/t123-kv-snapshot.json

# rollback example
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/pools/hotfix-1/config -d '{"prefix_bypass": false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

vic (sre): I'll set a soft quota: reduce T123 burst to 5 and sustained to 120 via rate-limiter.

sandeep (eng-oncall): Alright rolling canary now. tagging @elaine for handoff if this needs longer ops.

--- 6m later ---

deploy-bot: Canary applied to 2 pods. Observing.

elaine (eng-runtime): Observing metrics: kv-miss for the prefix decreased by ~18%, origin requests still higher than baseline but p95 latency improving slightly. No errors introduced.

sandeep (eng-oncall): Good. Start ramp: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m if metrics stay stable. vic, please watch origin CPU and backend error rates.

vic (sre): Watching. Also enabling temporary cache shielding: min-ttl bump from 60s -> 300s for non-prefetch keys to reduce churn.

jen (support): Customer impact summary for external comms: AcmeCorp experiencing increased tail latency and occasional 502s on webhook path. Affected transactions ~0.03% of total, but important high-value customer. Support drafting message.

sandeep (eng-oncall): If errors spike >0.5% or p95 >2s, we rollback to previous config. Keep me posted every 5 minutes.

--- 12m later ---

essay from ops-runbook-bot: runbook step completed: "throttle_applied", id=run-7782.

elaine (eng-runtime): Ramp to 50% done. kv-hit up another 10%. p95 latency for T123 now back to ~850ms. No 5xxs.

vic (sre): backend RPS from cache refill still 1.8x baseline but trending down. CPU ok.

jen (support): Customer note: sent an update that we're aware, mitigation in progress, expected improvements within 30m. :thumbsup:

sandeep (eng-oncall): Looks stable enough to ramp to 100%. After that we'll keep the throttles for 30m then gradually relax.

--- Handoff ---

sandeep (eng-oncall): I'm going to handoff to @elaine (eng-runtime) for midnight coverage and follow-up testing. Summary for handoff:
- incident-ts:2249990000
- root cause: hotkey-like surge causing KV cache thrash for prefix "pref-tenant-T123"
- mitigations applied: tenant throttle (120 rps), prefix_bypass on hotfix-1 pool, TTL bump on non-prefetch keys
- customer-impact: AcmeCorp slow responses, few 502s; support notified
- metrics snapshot: /tmp/t123-kv-snapshot.json
- rollback cmd: see earlier

elaine (eng-runtime): ACK handoff. I'll monitor for 2 hours and coordinate with support for follow-up. If we see regressions, will revert prefix_bypass then adjust autoscale.

vic (sre): adding post-incident action: add adaptive hotkey detection to runbook and automated short-circuit throttling for extreme hotspots.

sandeep (eng-oncall): thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Will open a postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> MITIGATED by sandeep. Incident channel: #incidents. If you were paged, please confirm by reacting :white_check_mark:.

jen (support): I'll follow up with AcmeCorp and include the mitigation summary.

elaine (eng-runtime): quick note: saving config diffs to /var/run/config-diffs/2249990000.patch

vic (sre): postmortem action items logged: HOTKEY_DETECT-45, RUNBOOK_UPDATE-12.

sandeep (eng-oncall): closing chat. Good job team. :tada:
